name: Yuutousei Kurashina Mutsumi ~Hamedori Nakadashi Douga~
original_name: 優等生倉科むつみ ～ハメ撮り膣射し動画～
source:
Honor student Kurashina Mutsumi studies hard day and night.

Neat and with an aura of gentleness, she is secretly adored by many male students, but she leads a peaceful school life oblivious to such things.

However, in order to save a friend of hers who is in financial trouble, she contacts a man through the internet and enters a deal with him, completely ignorant of the details.

Her voluptuous body brimming with youthfulness, normally covered under her uniform, is about to be exposed in front of a camera...

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/ftpsuyrso_0002/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
优等生仓科睦美日夜刻苦学习。

她整洁端庄，身上散发着温柔气质，暗中受到许多男学生爱慕，却对这一切一无所知，过着平静的校园生活。

然而，为了拯救陷入经济困境的朋友，她通过网络联系上一名男子，并在完全不了解细节的情况下与他达成交易。

平时藏在制服下、洋溢青春气息的丰满身体，即将暴露在镜头前……

[译自[url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/ftpsuyrso_0002/]DMM[/url]]
